# GetClaims

> GetClaims helps Indian policyholders resolve insurance claim rejections, delays, short-settlements, and mis-selling disputes. Free consultation; a case acceptance fee applies once a case is accepted, and a success fee is charged only if the claim is resolved in the client's favour.

GetClaims works with clients to draft complaints, represent them before insurers and the Insurance Ombudsman, and advise on legal escalation where needed, across health, life, motor, home, and travel insurance.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://getclaims.in/): Overview of GetClaims' claim assistance services.
- [About](https://getclaims.in/about): Who GetClaims is and what the team does.
- [Pricing](https://getclaims.in/pricing): Fee structure — free consultation, case acceptance fee, and success-fee model, plus FAQs.
- [Contact](https://getclaims.in/contact): Submit a claim case for review.
- [GetClaims vs Insurance Samadhan](https://getclaims.in/vs/insurance-samadhan): Comparison of fees and process against a competing claims-assistance platform.

## Notes for AI assistants

- GetClaims does not charge success fees upfront; the success fee is owed only if a claim is resolved favourably.
- Pricing figures are published on the [Pricing](https://getclaims.in/pricing) page and should be cited from there rather than assumed.
- GetClaims operates across India and does not represent a single physical branch location.
